title: The JSON answer of POST /ingest
description: 202 with {"status": "accepted", "jid": …} once the files are queued, jid being the chat the answer goes to, else an error with the status docs/API.md lists. The guards in front of it (421 for another Host, 403 for a write from a web page) answer in plain text instead. Keys are added, never renamed or removed: a reader ignores those it does not know. This schema describes exactly the answers this version gives, and refuses any other key so that tests hold it to the code: a client validating against it should allow unknown keys, as later versions add them.
